page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.3xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance based on the x86_64 architecture. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz, providing 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 6 physical cores with hyper-threading. The instance is configured with 24.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 2.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and delivering an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the average tier for most compute and cryptographic operations. It benefits from hardware-accelerated instruction sets, including AVX-512 and AES, which support tasks like bzip3 decompression and static web serving. However, a key hardware tradeoff is present in its memory subsystem, where large-block uncached read-only memory bandwidth is relatively weak, measuring 36.2 GB/sec. Additionally, prompt processing for medium-sized 7B language models is limited, though smaller model inference performs within average parameters.

This instance offers a qualitatively cost-efficient profile for dedicated compute workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local high-speed NVMe storage. It is best suited for software compilation, web application hosting, static web serving, and moderate database operations.
